parsed.post: Huge jump! 0.916 -> 0.855 val_bpb. Expanding shards to '0-10' was massive. I'm seeing significant gains. Next, I'll try decreasing MATRIX_LR slightly to see if the improved convergence allows for a more stable, lower learning rate to minimize noise.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.05 and introducing a small amount of WEIGHT_DECAY to see if more stable convergence leads to even lower bpb.
